login.title: Sign in to deskhaven
login.totpDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.codeHint: 6 digits, or a recovery code like abcde-fghij
login.setupPending: This server has no owner yet. Open the one-time setup link from the server log, or create a new one with `deskhaven admin create-setup-link`.

insecure.title: This connection is not secure
insecure.description: The console only works over HTTPS: on plain HTTP the browser discards the sign-in cookies, so you would be signed out right away.
insecure.proxy: Put deskhaven behind an HTTPS reverse proxy (and list the proxy in security.trusted_proxies), or
insecure.tunnel: reach it through an SSH tunnel and open http://localhost:21114:

reasons.denied: The sign-in was cancelled or denied at the identity provider.
reasons.unavailable: The identity provider is unavailable. Try again later.
reasons.invalid_token: The identity provider's answer could not be verified.
reasons.no_linked_account: No account is linked to this identity. Sign in with your password and link it under My account.
reasons.unverified: This account is not verified yet.
reasons.provisioning_failed: No account could be created for this identity.
reasons.expired: This sign-in link expired or was opened in another browser. Start again from the sign-in page.

setup.title: Set up deskhaven
setup.description: Create the owner account of this server.
setup.missingToken: Open the one-time setup link printed in the server log (it ends in #token=…), or create a new one with `deskhaven admin create-setup-link`.
setup.completed: This server is already set up.
setup.publicUrlHint: Clients and identity providers reach this server at its public URL (public_url in deskhaven.toml or DESKHAVEN_PUBLIC_URL; a restart applies it). Single sign-on and the client configuration need it.
setup.doneDescription: The owner account is ready. Client configuration (server address and key) is under Client setup in the console.
